project.title: Joint Consumer Experience
project.goal: Bring Tock venues into the Resy consumer experience, increasing their visibility and demand while reducing the overhead of maintaining multiple products and brands.
project.value: Diners get more discovery and dining options, and more value from their Resy credit through the channels they already use. For American Express, a wider network of the best restaurants delivers membership value to existing members and entices new card signups.
project.role: I was a lead designer on the search and availability squad, working on a cross-functional team with product and engineering.

next.title: Manager App
next.goal: Provide a simple, reliable tool that helps owners, operators, and teams stay prepared for every service, supporting the delivery of exceptional hospitality.
next.value: Exceptional hospitality and personalized experiences don't happen by accident. They require thoughtful preparation. Tock Manager simplifies reviewing guest details and planning ahead, helping teams execute each service with confidence so staff can focus on what matters most: delivering hospitality that stands out.
next.role: I was the only designer on a small innovation team with two senior iOS engineers. It was a new product, so I owned research, concepts, validation, final designs, and measurement, and acted as product owner for requirements and direction.
